author: Pallas), 1769
summary: 2012년 10월 천수만에서 처음 기록된 길잃은새로, 지금까지 국내 기록은 10건이 채 안 된다. 시베리아 북부 타이미르반도 일대의 툰드라에서 번식하고, 세계 개체군 대부분이 흑해 서부 연안의 루마니아·불가리아·우크라이나에서 겨울을 난다. 겨울에는 농경지에서 풀과 잎, 씨앗, 곡식의 새싹을 뜯어 먹으며, 길을 잃은 개체는 흔히 다른 기러기 무리에 섞여 지낸다. 국제자연보전연맹(IUCN) 적색목록의 취약(VU) 종이다.

art.subject: Red-breasted Goose (Branta ruficollis), adult: crown, face, hindneck and upperparts black; a white oval patch between the bill and the eye; a large brick-red patch on the cheek bordered with white; foreneck and breast brick-red, bordered by a narrow white line; a white stripe along the flanks below the wing; belly and flanks black; vent and undertail coverts white; wings black with two narrow white bars on the coverts. Bill tiny and black; dark eye; legs black.
art.pose: grazing on a harvested rice field among Greater White-fronted Geese, side view
art.scene: Korean winter farmland: harvested rice fields with stubble and a flock of grey geese; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on a field: short black bill, white patch between bill and eye, chestnut-red cheek patch outlined in white, chestnut-red foreneck and breast bordered with white, black back and belly, bold white flank stripe, two narrow white bars across the wing coverts, white vent and undertail coverts, black legs

adult in flight seen squarely from above: head, neck, body and tail in one line, wings spread straight out to the sides to their full span, black upperparts and upperwing with two narrow white covert bars, chestnut-red neck sides, white uppertail coverts contrasting with the black tail
art.build: Small, compact, short-necked goose, about the length of a Mallard but much stockier, the smallest goose likely to be seen in Korea. Bill tiny and stubby, much shorter than the head. Legs short, black. At rest the wings reach the tail tip. Grazes busily in fields with other geese; in flight looks dark with a white vent and white uppertail coverts.
avoid: Do not paint grey-brown body plumage; the body is black with white stripes.
Do not paint a long bill; it is very small and stubby.
Do not make the breast orange or pale pink; it is deep brick-red.
Do not omit the white borders around the red patches.
